scope: Page.setContent on pinned Chromium, macOS arm64, Bun 1.4.2 and Node 22.22.0/24.15.0. Frame.setContent and native Linux remain unverified. This is functionality, not E2E performance evidence.

contract.replacement: Real document.open/write/close in original isolated world, preserving main-frame URL, origin, execution worlds and live handles. Detached child worlds retire handles.
contract.transport: Exact UTF-16LE base64, maximum 1000000 UTF-16 code units; the exact boundary passes and boundary+1 rejects before browser effects. At most 128 pending replacement markers per page.
contract.completion: Default load; domcontentloaded, networkidle and commit; inherited navigation timeouts. Private original-world console marker clears previous load history/idle window and remains hidden from public console and trace.
contract.residentConditions: Reattach listeners and observation after document.open while retaining pending predicates and original deadlines.
contract.cancellation: Withdraw undispatched write or retire original page when browser completion is uncertain. Settled write followed by load timeout retains usable page.
contract.tracing: Original call owns Before and After main-frame snapshot references.

review.finding: Before snapshot dispatch omitted page.setContent. Added the method and verified both original-call snapshot references against real traces.
review.result: No additional concrete lifecycle, cancellation, ownership, stale-marker or resource-limit bug identified in independent read-only review.
review.metadataRefresh: Implementation-only hashes refreshed in 25 existing upstream provenance files, plus new content provenance. Upstream extracts and existing semantic claims unchanged. Two preceding guardian source references were already stale; verified guardian checkpoint remains separate evidence. All 35 provenance check scripts pass.

retainedFailures.reason: Prototype passed Arc<Chromium> to ResourceOwner; corrected by borrowing Chromium.
Private fixture loaded both test-runner copies in one process; separated engine processes.
Fixture incorrectly expected later replacement to release outstanding image loads; pinned reference timed out. Corrected resource gate; original failure retained.
New fixture reused an existing top-level variable name; corrected before registry execution.

limitations: Experimental Page-only API; no Frame.setContent claim.
No signal option: pinned1.60 declarations remain authoritative.
Networkidle retains existing explicit cross-process-child-frame limitation.
Packed content checks ran on Bun in ESM/CommonJS; Node22/24 passed the separate public differential fixture.
Current full-core, representative majority-scenario 2x E2E performance, native Linux and release publication gates remain open.
